method: Deterministic per-pixel linear-light head white balance and max 0.10-stop feathered face shadow lift. Fractional perimeter RGB with observed blue spill is decontaminated from adjacent opaque subject pixels; bright-halo correction is restricted to hair. Original alpha, geometry and clothing texture are preserved; hands/watch are excluded. No generation, spatial skin filtering or sharpening.

avif.reason: Lossless AVIF is larger than lossless WebP; lower-quality AVIF changed alpha. WebP selected to preserve every visible RGB and alpha value.
